testcase.system-out: Scenario: extrusion-03c Choose named directions with the dropdown selector ✔> Given the MCAD Software is displaying a part in the solid modeling workspace ✔> And the viewport pointer is idle ✔ Given the rectangle extrusion preview is open with icon direction controls ✔ When the user opens the Direction menu ✔ Then Selector Style offers Icons and Dropdown ✔ And Icons is selected ✔ When the user chooses Dropdown ✔ Then the Direction field displays Default ✔ When the user opens the Direction list ✔ Then it offers Default, Flipped, Symmetric and Asymmetric ✔ When the user opens the Direction menu and chooses Icons ✔ Then the four direction icons are visible again
